summary: Investigated Telegram messaging in MYTHOS. Current implementation is complete for task lifecycle notifications with proper security (no IDs/paths shown), anti-spam, and owner-facing text. Missing: (1) periodic 6-hour status reports showing RAM/CPU/services; (2) immediate alerts for Resource Guard state changes (CRITICAL/WARNING) with built-in rate-limiting. Both require new features but reuse existing data collection and message patterns already proven.

Alert system not wired to Resource Guard transition events
